item.description:
Smarter agents, and Cove knows who you are

  • Agents think with more context: Jev now sees the whole conversation, how often you hear from the sender, what you told Cove about yourself, and your past answers, and explains each decision in one line.
  • Agents can also archive, flag, mark read or create a Google Task when a rule matches.
  • A clearer Activity: emails look like your inbox, with the reader beside them and Right / Wrong — undo, Yes and No. Every answer teaches the agent.
  • Try it shows what would happen, what's unclear and what didn't match, with the reason for each, and shows errors plainly.
  • About you (Agent → About you): who you are, what you're working on, notes and your sign-off, used in every draft and Ask Cove answer. Cove can suggest it from your sent mail.
